_comment: GENERATED by scripts/amendments.py. One ledger per phase, beside verdict.json.
An amendment is a post-verification change that names the requirement ids it touches, so
only those re-verify. Without it, a one-line correction cost a full verification round: one
measured phase ran eight attempts and rounds 3 through 8 were that shape.
Ordinary amendments are BATCHED and re-verified together at phase close. A security-relevant
one is NEVER batched - it is owed re-verification immediately, because the cost argument that
justifies batching does not apply to a credential already in a log.
A reason that quantifies universally carries the set it was measured over as `measured_over`,
a field the Verifier holds the claim against (issue #117): 'nothing in the catalogue' was written
against a four-field diff and cost two rounds to falsify. `open` refuses the reason without it.
Do not hand-edit: `amendments.py open` and `amendments.py close` own this file, and
`amendments.py due` is what the verifier hook and CI read.
readers: avenger-verifier @ per phase, to scope the re-verify set

amendments.reason: <why the change was made, from the reason file>
measured_over: <the set a universal claim in the reason was checked over - required when the reason says all/every/nothing/never/always/only/...; null otherwise>
